name: set
description:
Set a single, non-secret configuration value.

A value of the wrong form is refused with exit 2 and the form the key takes; lists takes a JSON list of folders.
The version the project needs is not checked here, so cli.min_version can be lowered.
With --dry-run the config is not written.

Example: semkit config set cli.min_version 0.2.0

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would happen without making changes.

arguments.name: key
arguments.description: Dotted config key, e.g. cli.min_version (see `config list`).

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: New value: text for a text key, JSON for any other, as 2 or '["/abs/lists"]'.
